about: Dates of the holidays that have no rule the page can work out (the others come from the calendars of the engine, ike/resources/greeting.js). Diwali: the main day (Lakshmi Puja); Holi: Dhulandi; Lunar New Year: the day it falls on in China (the engine's own calendar is a day off in some years, 2027 among them, so these years are listed and other years come from the engine); Vesak: the full moon of May as the Theravada calendar of Sri Lanka keeps it (other countries differ). Written by hand from the published calendars and NOT yet checked against an authoritative source: to be verified and refreshed every year.
